description: This Java source file defines a class 'FindByAnd' which implements an entity operation for the OFBiz mini-language. It represents the <find-by-and> element, allowing retrieval of entities based on multiple conditions combined with AND. The class manages the parsing of XML attributes, uses flexible string expander and map accessor utilities to handle dynamic input, and performs database queries using OFBiz's EntityQuery facilities.
